annotations.title: Audit Pre-Route Vendor Stackup, 50-Ohm RF & VIPPO Rules

description: Validate a multi-layer vendor dielectric stackup before routing to compute the exact 50-Ohm RF microstrip width (mm), 3*H1 top-layer coplanar ground pour pullback clearance (mm), reference-plane corridor half-width (mm), and Via-in-Pad Plated Over (VIPPO) policy. Call this tool prior to routing mixed-signal or RF boards (2.4 GHz BLE/Wi-Fi, Sub-GHz LoRa, cellular, or GNSS). Inputs specify top_prepreg_h1_mm (mm), outer_copper_um (micrometers), and prepreg_er. Returns JSON with status, recommended_microstrip_50ohm_width_mm, required_isolated_microstrip_pour_gap_mm, and reference_corridor_half_width_mm to bind into netclass rules.

outer_copper_um.description: Finished outer copper thickness in micrometers (um, >= 9.0 um). Use 35.0 for 1 oz finished copper or 17.5 for 0.5 oz.

pcb_text.description: Optional raw UTF-8 .kicad_pcb S-expression text for board context inspection. Example: '(kicad_pcb (version 20240108) ...)'.

prepreg_er.description: Relative permittivity (Er / Dk) of the top prepreg dielectric layer (>= 1.5). Example: 4.29 for standard 7628 FR-4.

project_path.description: Optional local filesystem path to the target .kicad_pcb file in local STDIO mode. Example: 'rf_carrier.kicad_pcb'.

top_prepreg_h1_mm.description: Outer prepreg dielectric height H1 between F.Cu and In1.Cu in millimeters (mm, >= 0.04 mm). Example: 0.19 for 7628 or 0.10 for 2116 prepreg.

transmission_line_mode.description: RF transmission line structure: 'isolated_microstrip' (enforces 3*H1 top ground pour pullback) or 'cpwg' (coplanar waveguide with ground).

vippo_mode.description: Via-in-Pad policy: 'disallow_via_in_paste' (standard SMT fabrication, relocates vias out of solder paste apertures) or 'allow_vippo_type_vii' (resin-filled & capped IPC-4761 Type VII).
